name: reasoning-workflow
description: A general-purpose reasoning and deep-research workflow with semantic state, traceability, validation, and change control.

interface.shortDescription: Reason, research, decide, execute, and verify with traceable state
interface.longDescription: A general governing workflow for substantive agent tasks. It treats question answering and project execution as two first-class lanes, adds adaptive inquiry and evidence reasoning, and enforces typed semantic state, transitive invalidation, closure rules, delivery reconciliation, provenance, and runtime validation.
defaultPrompt: Use Reasoning Workflow to analyze this at the deepest useful level.
Investigate this question and challenge the leading explanation.
Plan and execute this task with traceable state and verification.
